content.short: Issuer of EURØP, a regulated and fully backed euro stablecoin for on-chain payments.
content.description: Schuman Financial wants the euro to catch up on-chain, where euro stablecoins make up less than 1% of the market. It issues EURØP, a MiCA-compliant euro stablecoin backed one to one by reserves, and qualified businesses can mint and redeem it against euros through its platform. The token is designed for near-instant, low-cost transfers in euros, and it is available on networks including Ethereum and Plasma.
